scope: Implementation-before contract for the K14 Android SoM (set-of-mark) screenshot gap: same-observation nodes -> stable 1-based numbers -> annotated PNG plus bounded mapping. Documentation only; no source, tests, migration, route, model, device or database change.

grounding.reference: xuexi/android-agent 7c09f6cd screenshot_annotated: set-of-mark overlay matching get_elements indices; visual annotation only, not action approval.
grounding.v2_primitives: android_observe nodes (node_id/bounds/class/actions/password/visible), CapturedFrame/session_captures/objects and the existing image codec caps (PNG, 8192 side, 16M pixels, 16MiB).
grounding.gap: V2_ANDROID_AUDIT group 2 records screenshot_annotated/SoM as an offline gap; no implementation exists.

decisions_pending_owner: D0 visible surface: offline core adapter only / android_observe mark option / owner-only HTTP route; default offline core
D1 output publication: reuse session_captures/objects (recommended) / caller temp only; no new table
D2 numbering: observe order 1-based (recommended, matches indices) / spatial order
D3 failure semantics: explicit android_som_* error, never a half-rendered image
contract_boundaries: Only an already owner-authorized screenshot and the same observation's nodes; no new capture, OCR, model call or device action.
Only visible nodes with valid bounds; password nodes are never marked or numbered; <=50 marks, observe order 1-based, stable numbering.
Bounds are clipped to the image; fully out-of-bounds nodes are skipped and counted; truncated output is explicit.
The annotated PNG keeps image dimensions, contains only numbers (no node text/node_id/path/sha in pixels), and respects the existing image caps.
Output reuses session_captures/objects with grant/session/content_epoch, source-erasure barriers and no automatic model attachment, memory or persona write.
D0 undecided means no new model tool or HTTP route; shared capability/route changes go through A.
